Changeset: 169809 Modified procgen world setup to move `Caves` above `Power Line Layout` to prevent floating powerlines over caves. Cave terrain blend was lowering terrain under already placed powerlines.
Changeset: 169916 Made icelake placement much fairer so Ice Lake 4 isn't disproportionately spawning compared to the other 3 variants - larger icelakes now spawn more often.
Changeset: 170343 Missed lake blend texture
Changeset: 170339 Increased radius of Lake C slightly to include blends and terrain splat/sculpt. Regenerated terrain anchors with new blend based script. Slightly gentler tolerances now.

Changeset: 170337 Reduced blend and increased radius of Oasis B slightly so that they marry up better. Regenerated terrain anchors with new blend-based script, should be better in super hilly spots now. S2P.

Changeset: 170273 Removed stray terrain tile from compound prefab. Softened splat blend slightly to improve transition in arid areas. Repainted blend to fall within radius/fade. S2P. Tested in proc map.
Changeset: 170229 Reduced and softened blend of Excavator. Reduced radius/fade slightly to better fit. Regenerated terrain anchors with new blend based component. S2P. Tested in proc map.

Changeset: 170215 Shrank blend map to be closer to monument radius and softened blur. Bumped radius up slightly to 115m to improve terrain anchor generation. Re-generated terrain anchors with new blend-based component. S2P. Tested in procmap.

Changeset: 170088 Bunker entrance source scene - reduced radius/fade to be closer to monument footprint. Removed unncessary paint data (out of bounds) from splat maps to clean up falloff. Reduced blend map to fade to 0 within monument radius. Propagated changes to bunker entrance a-d prefabs. Tested in procmap.
Changeset: 170071 Draw monument gizmos when editing terrain to help line up painting blend/splat within the radius and topology bounds
Changeset: 170062 Slightly reduced radius and fade of radtown to reduce overreach. Smoothed radtown blend and pulled it in slightly where it extended past the radius. S2P. Checked in procmap.
Changeset: 170049 Reduced tile size and terrain map size of jungle_ruins_d to reduce radius overhang and unused splats. Ran S2P. Reviewed changes in procmap.
Changeset: 169997 Slightly lowered radius, fade, and blend map of satellite scene to stop huge radius overhang
Changeset: 169973 Painted apartment complex blend to better fit inside Jacob's improved radius visualisation
Changeset: 169967 Fixed monument editor gizmo to ensure Radius is always centered correctly. Added a separate square to mark the topology footprint
Changeset: 169959 Repainted apartments blend map so it falls within monument radius
Changeset: 169953 Testing auto resizing apartments monument terrain tile + textures to reduce footprint
Changeset: 169987 Don't paint grass or forest splat on ocean or oceanside terrain when placing monuments - fixes large monuments sometimes painting green patches under water

Changeset: 170006 Speculative fix for ocean water appearing inside canyons placed near the shore - extended Mountain topology on `ue_canyon_[abc]` to prevent Water topology where canyons dig below sea level.  This required a small radius increase on `ue_canyon_b` & S2P
Changeset: 170030 Fixed edge cases of the CH47 crate landing on top of the powerline pole at powerplant
Changeset: 170197 Persist the UID water mark across server restarts, eliminating the risk of ever reusing a net id of a killed entity
Changeset: 169030 !Initial fix
Changeset: 170386 Accompanying code changes to ensure the new rail gravel meshes are still placed with the pivot on the rail line so the extended mesh goes into the terrain

Changeset: 170383 Changed train track procgen material to be opaque to get more UV space out of the gravel part (don't need visual blend on the gravel skirt now as it should always be well under terrain)
Changeset: 170369 Train tracks - added bottom faces to procgen rails LOD0. Added deeper gravel skirt to all LODs to improve embedding in terrain.

Changeset: 170299 Extended the Rail Lift stage to also fix any floating rails (pre-existing to cs170256), this could happen at a junction where one rail goes uphill but the lower rail sculpts terrain from underneath the other.

Changeset: 170256 Fixed railway tracks getting buried by terrain from TerrainHeightSet smoothing of cliff backfaces as well as rail terrain and road terrain stages - new World Setup stage 80 `Rail Lift` to look for buried rail and gently raise. Overlapping rails/junctions/sidings are lifted together so junctions line up.

Changeset: 170107 Fixed shore ice spawning over railway tracks - added a Rail TerrainFilter to `shore_ice_[abc]` to reject ice placement over rail topology. Existing checks at single points easily failed. Tested in editor, resolved.
Changeset: 170491 ! Fix BaseEntity.OnValidate assigning the model from a nested entity on the parent

Changeset: 170552 Fixed Nuclear Missile Silo terrain sometimes clipping over the doorway and underground tunnels, very fiddly to fix whilst preserving terrain auto-lowering. Tested on multiple 6000-sized maps to stress test terrain texel resolution
